demos.name: Privilege Semantic Cache LAB
demos.description: Per-key semantic caching: a similar prompt is answered from the key's cache (HIT with its score against the strictness, TTL on a lab clock, Usage: Requests, From cache, Saved). Nine scenarios. Mock only; the encoder is a stand-in, not a real embedding model; the rest is UNVERIFIED.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7847, PROVISIONAL: claimed provisionally, not registered on the board). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials; Real is not built (the toggle is disabled with the reason). Docker: HOST_PORT=7847 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). catalogId D000 is a placeholder: the owner assigns the real catalog id and the port before the registry entry is made. Repo: curtismu7/privilege-semantic-cache-LAB.
